newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Monti presents energy tax plan to ECOFIN Council.
newsitem.headline: Monti presents energy tax plan to ECOFIN Council.

text.p: Internal Market Commissioner Mario Monti presented on Monday the recently adopted energy taxation proposal to EU finance ministers but any serious debate will have to wait a few months, Commission and diplomats said.
The proposal aims at increasing minimum tax levels on motor and heating fuels as well as to extend them to electricity and natural gas.

British Chancellor of the Exchequer (Finance Minister) Kenneth Clarke said last week he would oppose the plan because of the extension to the products at stake. Britain is the EU's largest producer of natural gas.
Spain last week also voiced concern about the plan because it would provoke a rise in diesel prices.
Dutch Finance Minister Gerrit Zalm told reporters that the ministers did not discuss the plan on Monday.
The Commission's proposal needs to be approved unanimously to become law.
